repos.name: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
repos.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
repos.eli5: It’s like a super‑smart detective that helps security experts find hidden bugs in websites, using a chat‑bot that knows all the tricks.

repos.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.eli5: It works like a news‑gathering robot that reads the internet for the past month and writes a short, easy‑to‑understand summary for you.

repos.name: alibaba/open-code-review
repos.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.eli5: Imagine a robot teacher that reads the changes you made to code and points out mistakes line by line, just like a helpful tutor.

repos.name: Tencent/LoopForge
repos.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
repos.eli5: It’s a kitchen where you tell a robot chef what you want, it cooks the code, and you can set up recipes (workflows) to repeat the same dish every time.

repos.name: dream-num/univer
repos.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
repos.eli5: Think of it as a digital office building where you can add spreadsheets, docs, and calculators that both people and AI helpers can use together.

repos.name: getarcaneapp/arcane
repos.description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone
repos.eli5: It’s a friendly remote control for Docker containers, letting anyone start, stop, and manage apps without needing to be a Docker expert.

repos.name: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
repos.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
repos.eli5: It’s a toolbox of tiny robot helpers that you can plug into a bigger AI system, giving it new abilities like designing or building things.

repos.name: cursor/plugins
repos.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
repos.eli5: These are like add‑on apps for a coding assistant, giving it extra powers such as teaching, remembering notes, or checking code safety.

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.eli5: It’s a playbook that tells coding robots how to work together step by step, so they can build software without getting confused.

repos.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
repos.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
repos.eli5: It’s a universal language that lets AI helpers talk to any app, like a translator that lets a robot and a game understand each other.
